questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg valgte at tage til et engelsktalende land, så jeg kunne snakke med lokalbefolkningen.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Universitetet sendte mange e-mails med al den nødvendige information.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik mails og kontaktoplysninger på vejledere.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes at det var let at finde bolig off campus. Austin er en dyr by, så jeg vil anbefale at kigge efter co-op, hvor huslejen er billigere. Man får først at vide nogle måneder forinden studiestart om man har fået en plads i en co-op, men de fleste har mange ledige værelser.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Man kan sagtens leve off campus, det er både muligt at gå til campus og man kan køre gratis med busserne med ens studiekort.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Registrering til fag for udvekslingsstuderende åbnede først op fem dage inden studiestart, hvilket betyd at mange fag var fyldt op. Ved tilmeldingen kan man sige at et lukket fag skal erstatte et åbent fag, hvis der skulle opstå ledige pladser, så man skal løbende holde øje med fagene. Nogle fag har krav man skal opfylde for at kunne tilmelde sig, i de tilfælde så skriv til professoren.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Både professorer og studievejleder var meget villige til at hjælpe og svarede hurtigt på ens henvendelser.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg endte med at få alle de fag jeg skulle have.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg vil anbefale at have flere mulige fagkombinationer, så du ikke er låst til at du skal have fire specifikke fag. Det gør det lettere hvis du fra ku's side ikke skal have obligatoriske fag.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg havde to upper-division fag, et introduktions-fag og et kandidat fag.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Vi var ca. 40 studerende og en professor det for det meste holdt et oplæg. Professoren stillede spørgsmål undervejs og engagerede de studerende. De fleste fag endte med at vi skulle holde en fremlæggelse foran hele holdet.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
EUS 305 Introduction to European Studies, 
GOV 365V Comprehensive Notions of European Security, 
GOV 360G Causes of War, 
GOV 290K Comparative Study of Political Systems

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg vil anbefale at tage Comprehensive Notions of European Security, hvor du får et indblik i europæiske sikkerhed ud fra et amerikansk perspektiv. Du vil få en bedre forståelse for både NATO og OSCE. Dr. Mosser er super dygtig og engageret. Han har fuldstændig styr på hvad der foregår i verden og kan sætte det i perspektiv til det vi lærer om.

questions.answer: Der er mange gebyrer, der samlet var på 7.200 kr. for administration og visum. Gebyrer for bare universitets administration, når man er i Texas løb op i 1.800 kr.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer:
Jeg fandt alle bøger online gennem
sorg.kb
eller på universitetsbiblioteket. Jeg blev overrasket over at busserne i Austin var gratis med studiekort.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der er mange foreninger du kan blive en del af. På campus er der næsten dagligt borde langs stien hvor du kan høre om de forskellige foreninger. Langt de fleste foreninger har ikke krav for optagelse.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Alt tænkeligt.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg vil opfordrer til at prøve at blive en del af en gruppe eller to og gøre brug af de mange de akademiske oplæg der løbende er der og alle de gratis arrangementer for studerende.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag rundt i byen og oplev de forskellige bydele, besøg museerne og naturstederne.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Overraskende nemt

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Tag til undervisning i god tid og snak med folk omkring dig, blev en del af nogle grupper.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Amerikansk høflighedsfraser.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Deres åbenhed overfor at snakke med fremmede og inviterer en med.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Drik en masse vand, der er varmt i Texas om efteråret. 
Tag amerikanerne på ordet og aftal et tidspunkt, hvor I mødes. 
Vær åben for at snakke med folk, du normalt ikke ville opsøge.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er mange små opgaver hver uge i ens fag, så du bliver nødt til ugentligt at sætte timer af til at få læst pensum og lavet opgaverne.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Venskaberne.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Vende sig til varmen.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Det er fagligt lettere, men arbejdsbyrden er større. Det er det hele værd.

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
